verses.en: And God said unto Jacob, Arise, go up to Bethel, and dwell there: and make there an altar unto God, that appeared unto thee when thou fleddest from the face of Esau thy brother.
verses.pt: Depois disse Deus a Jacó: Levanta-te, sobe a Betel e habita ali; e faze ali um altar ao Deus que te apareceu quando fugias da face de Esaú, teu irmão.
verses.en_web: God said to Jacob, “Arise, go up to Bethel, and live there. Make there an altar to God, who appeared to you when you fled from the face of Esau your brother.”
verses.en_bbe: And God said to Jacob, Go up now to Beth-el and make your living-place there: and put up an altar there to the God who came to you when you were in flight from your brother Esau.

verses.en: Then Jacob said unto his household, and to all that were with him, Put away the strange gods that are among you, and be clean, and change your garments:
verses.pt: Então disse Jacó à sua família, e a todos os que com ele estavam: Lançai fora os deuses estranhos que há no meio de vós, e purificai-vos e mudai as vossas vestes.
verses.en_web: Then Jacob said to his household, and to all who were with him, “Put away the foreign gods that are among you, purify yourselves, change your garments.
verses.en_bbe: Then Jacob said to all his people, Put away the strange gods which are among you, and make yourselves clean, and put on a change of clothing:

verses.en: And let us arise, and go up to Bethel; and I will make there an altar unto God, who answered me in the day of my distress, and was with me in the way which I went.
verses.pt: Levantemo-nos, e subamos a Betel; ali farei um altar ao Deus que me respondeu no dia da minha angústia, e que foi comigo no caminho por onde andei.
verses.en_web: Let us arise, and go up to Bethel. I will make there an altar to God, who answered me in the day of my distress, and was with me on the way which I went.”
verses.en_bbe: And let us go up to Beth-el: and there I will make an altar to God, who gave me an answer in the day of my trouble, and was with me wherever I went.

verses.en: And they gave unto Jacob all the strange gods which were in their hand, and all their earrings which were in their ears; and Jacob hid them under the oak which was by Shechem.
verses.pt: Entregaram, pois, a Jacó todos os deuses estranhos, que tinham nas mãos, e as arrecadas que pendiam das suas orelhas; e Jacó os escondeu debaixo do carvalho que está junto a Siquém.
verses.en_web: They gave to Jacob all the foreign gods which were in their hands, and the rings which were in their ears; and Jacob hid them under the oak which was by Shechem.
verses.en_bbe: Then they gave to Jacob all the strange gods which they had, and the rings which were in their ears; and Jacob put them away under the holy tree at Shechem.

verses.en: And they journeyed: and the terror of God was upon the cities that were round about them, and they did not pursue after the sons of Jacob.
verses.pt: Então partiram; e o terror de Deus sobreveio às cidades que lhes estavam ao redor, de modo que não perseguiram os filhos de Jacó.
verses.en_web: They traveled, and a terror of God was on the cities that were around them, and they didn’t pursue the sons of Jacob.
verses.en_bbe: So they went on their journey: and the fear of God was on the towns round about, so that they made no attack on the sons of Jacob.

verses.en: So Jacob came to Luz, which is in the land of Canaan, that is, Bethel, he and all the people that were with him.
verses.pt: Assim chegou Jacó à Luz, que está na terra de Canaã (esta é Betel), ele e todo o povo que estava com ele.
verses.en_web: So Jacob came to Luz (that is, Bethel), which is in the land of Canaan, he and all the people who were with him.
verses.en_bbe: And Jacob came to Luz in the land of Canaan (which is the same as Beth-el), he and all his people.

verses.en: And he built there an altar, and called the place El-beth-el: because there God appeared unto him, when he fled from the face of his brother.
verses.pt: Edificou ali um altar, e chamou ao lugar El-Betel; porque ali Deus se lhe tinha manifestado quando fugia da face de seu irmão.
verses.en_web: He built an altar there, and called the place El Beth El; because there God was revealed to him, when he fled from the face of his brother.
verses.en_bbe: And there he made an altar, naming the place El-beth-el: because it was there he had the vision of God when he was in flight from his brother.

verses.en: But Deborah Rebekah’s nurse died, and she was buried beneath Bethel under an oak: and the name of it was called Allon-bachuth.
verses.pt: Morreu Débora, a ama de Rebeca, e foi sepultada ao pé de Betel, debaixo do carvalho, ao qual se chamou Alom-Bacute.
verses.en_web: Deborah, Rebekah’s nurse, died, and she was buried below Bethel under the oak; and its name was called Allon Bacuth.
verses.en_bbe: And Deborah, the servant who had taken care of Rebekah from her birth, came to her end, and was put to rest near Beth-el, under the holy tree: and they gave it the name of Allon-bacuth.

verses.en: And God appeared unto Jacob again, when he came out of Padan-aram, and blessed him.
verses.pt: Apareceu Deus outra vez a Jacó, quando ele voltou de Padã-Arã, e o abençoou.
verses.en_web: God appeared to Jacob again, when he came from Paddan Aram, and blessed him.
verses.en_bbe: Now when Jacob was on his way from Paddan-aram, God came to him again and, blessing him, said,

verses.en: And God said unto him, Thy name is Jacob: thy name shall not be called any more Jacob, but Israel shall be thy name: and he called his name Israel.
verses.pt: E disse-lhe Deus: O teu nome é Jacó; não te chamarás mais Jacó, mas Israel será o teu nome. Chamou-lhe Israel.
verses.en_web: God said to him, “Your name is Jacob. Your name shall not be Jacob any more, but your name will be Israel.” He named him Israel.
verses.en_bbe: Jacob is your name, but it will be so no longer; from now your name will be Israel; so he was named Israel.

verses.en: And God said unto him, I am God Almighty: be fruitful and multiply; a nation and a company of nations shall be of thee, and kings shall come out of thy loins;
verses.pt: Disse-lhe mais: Eu sou Deus Todo-Poderoso; frutifica e multiplica-te; uma nação, sim, uma multidão de nações sairá de ti, e reis procederão dos teus lombos;
verses.en_web: God said to him, “I am God Almighty. Be fruitful and multiply. A nation and a company of nations will be from you, and kings will come out of your body.
verses.en_bbe: And God said to him, I am God, the Ruler of all: be fertile, and have increase; a nation, truly a group of nations, will come from you, and kings will be your offspring;

verses.en: And the land which I gave Abraham and Isaac, to thee I will give it, and to thy seed after thee will I give the land.
verses.pt: a terra que dei a Abraão e a Isaque, a ti a darei; também à tua descendência depois de ti a darei.
verses.en_web: The land which I gave to Abraham and Isaac, I will give it to you, and to your offspring after you will I give the land.”
verses.en_bbe: And the land which I gave to Abraham and Isaac, I will give to you; and to your seed after you I will give the land.

verses.en: And God went up from him in the place where he talked with him.
verses.pt: E Deus subiu dele, do lugar onde lhe falara.
verses.en_web: God went up from him in the place where he spoke with him.
verses.en_bbe: Then God went up from him in the place where he had been talking with him.

verses.en: And Jacob set up a pillar in the place where he talked with him, even a pillar of stone: and he poured a drink offering thereon, and he poured oil thereon.
verses.pt: Então Jacó erigiu uma coluna no lugar onde Deus lhe falara, uma coluna de pedra; e sobre ela derramou uma libação e deitou-lhe também azeite;
verses.en_web: Jacob set up a pillar in the place where he spoke with him, a pillar of stone. He poured out a drink offering on it, and poured oil on it.
verses.en_bbe: And Jacob put up a pillar in the place where he had been talking with God, and put a drink offering on it, and oil.

verses.en: And Jacob called the name of the place where God spake with him, Bethel.
verses.pt: e Jacó chamou Betel ao lugar onde Deus lhe falara.
verses.en_web: Jacob called the name of the place where God spoke with him “Bethel”.
verses.en_bbe: And he gave to the place where God had been talking with him, the name of Beth-el.

verses.en: And they journeyed from Bethel; and there was but a little way to come to Ephrath: and Rachel travailed, and she had hard labour.
verses.pt: Depois partiram de Betel; e, faltando ainda um trecho pequeno para chegar a Efrata, Raquel começou a sentir dores de parto, e custou-lhe o dar à luz.
verses.en_web: They traveled from Bethel. There was still some distance to come to Ephrath, and Rachel travailed. She had hard labor.
verses.en_bbe: So they went on from Beth-el; and while they were still some distance from Ephrath, the pains of birth came on Rachel and she had a hard time.

verses.en: And it came to pass, when she was in hard labour, that the midwife said unto her, Fear not; thou shalt have this son also.
verses.pt: Quando ela estava nas dores do parto, disse-lhe a parteira: Não temas, pois ainda terás este filho.
verses.en_web: When she was in hard labor, the midwife said to her, “Don’t be afraid, for now you will have another son.”
verses.en_bbe: And when her pain was very great, the woman who was helping her said, Have no fear; for now you will have another son.

verses.en: And it came to pass, as her soul was in departing, (for she died) that she called his name Ben-oni: but his father called him Benjamin.
verses.pt: Então Raquel, ao sair-lhe a alma (porque morreu), chamou ao filho Benôni; mas seu pai chamou-lhe Benjamim.
verses.en_web: As her soul was departing (for she died), she named him Benoni, but his father named him Benjamin.
verses.en_bbe: And in the hour when her life went from her (for death came to her), she gave the child the name Ben-oni: but his father gave him the name of Benjamin.

verses.en: And Rachel died, and was buried in the way to Ephrath, which is Bethlehem.
verses.pt: Assim morreu Raquel, e foi sepultada no caminho de Efrata (esta é Bete-Leém).
verses.en_web: Rachel died, and was buried on the way to Ephrath (also called Bethlehem).
verses.en_bbe: So Rachel came to her end and was put to rest on the road to Ephrath (which is Beth-lehem).

verses.en: And Jacob set a pillar upon her grave: that is the pillar of Rachel’s grave unto this day.
verses.pt: E Jacó erigiu uma coluna sobre a sua sepultura; esta é a coluna da sepultura de Raquel até o dia de hoje.
verses.en_web: Jacob set up a pillar on her grave. The same is the Pillar of Rachel’s grave to this day.
verses.en_bbe: And Jacob put up a pillar on her resting-place; which is named, The Pillar of the resting-place of Rachel, to this day.

verses.en: And Israel journeyed, and spread his tent beyond the tower of Edar.
verses.pt: Então partiu Israel, e armou a sua tenda além de Migdal-Eder.
verses.en_web: Israel traveled, and spread his tent beyond the tower of Eder.
verses.en_bbe: And Israel went journeying on and put up his tents on the other side of the tower of the flock.

verses.en: And it came to pass, when Israel dwelt in that land, that Reuben went and lay with Bilhah his father’s concubine: and Israel heard it. Now the sons of Jacob were twelve:
verses.pt: Quando Israel habitava naquela terra, foi Rúben e deitou-se com Bila, concubina de seu pai; e Israel o soube. Eram doze os filhos de Jacó:
verses.en_web: While Israel lived in that land, Reuben went and lay with Bilhah, his father’s concubine, and Israel heard of it. Now the sons of Jacob were twelve.
verses.en_bbe: Now while they were living in that country, Reuben had connection with Bilhah, his father's servant-woman: and Israel had news of it.

verses.en: The sons of Leah; Reuben, Jacob’s firstborn, and Simeon, and Levi, and Judah, and Issachar, and Zebulun:
verses.pt: Os filhos de Léia: Rúben o primogênito de Jacó, depois Simeão, Levi, Judá, Issacar e Zebulom;
verses.en_web: The sons of Leah: Reuben (Jacob’s firstborn), Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, and Zebulun.
verses.en_bbe: Now Jacob had twelve sons: the sons of Leah: Reuben, Jacob's first son, and Simeon and Levi and Judah and Issachar and Zebulun;

verses.en: The sons of Rachel; Joseph, and Benjamin:
verses.pt: os filhos de Raquel: José e Benjamim;
verses.en_web: The sons of Rachel: Joseph and Benjamin.
verses.en_bbe: The sons of Rachel: Joseph and Benjamin;

verses.en: And the sons of Bilhah, Rachel’s handmaid; Dan, and Naphtali:
verses.pt: os filhos de Bila, serva de Raquel: Dã e Naftali;
verses.en_web: The sons of Bilhah (Rachel’s servant): Dan and Naphtali.
verses.en_bbe: The sons of Bilhah, Rachel's servant: Dan and Naphtali;

verses.en: And the sons of Zilpah, Leah’s handmaid; Gad, and Asher: these are the sons of Jacob, which were born to him in Padan-aram.
verses.pt: os filhos de Zilpa, serva de Léia: Gade e Aser. Estes são os filhos de Jacó, que lhe nasceram em Padã-Arã.
verses.en_web: The sons of Zilpah (Leah’s servant): Gad and Asher. These are the sons of Jacob, who were born to him in Paddan Aram.
verses.en_bbe: The sons of Zilpah, Leah's servant: Gad and Asher; these are the sons whom Jacob had in Paddan-aram.

verses.en: And Jacob came unto Isaac his father unto Mamre, unto the city of Arbah, which is Hebron, where Abraham and Isaac sojourned.
verses.pt: Jacó veio a seu pai Isaque, a Manre, a Quiriate-Arba (esta é Hebrom), onde peregrinaram Abraão e Isaque.
verses.en_web: Jacob came to Isaac his father, to Mamre, to Kiriath Arba (which is Hebron), where Abraham and Isaac lived as foreigners.
verses.en_bbe: And Jacob came to his father Isaac at Mamre, at Kiriath-arba, that is, Hebron, where Abraham and Isaac had been living.

verses.en: And the days of Isaac were an hundred and fourscore years.
verses.pt: Foram os dias de Isaque cento e oitenta anos;
verses.en_web: The days of Isaac were one hundred eighty years.
verses.en_bbe: And Isaac was a hundred and eighty years old.

verses.en: And Isaac gave up the ghost, and died, and was gathered unto his people, being old and full of days: and his sons Esau and Jacob buried him.
verses.pt: e, exalando o espírito, morreu e foi congregado ao seu povo, velho e cheio de dias; e Esaú e Jacó, seus filhos, o sepultaram.
verses.en_web: Isaac gave up the spirit, and died, and was gathered to his people, old and full of days. Esau and Jacob, his sons, buried him.
verses.en_bbe: Then Isaac came to his end and was put to rest with his father's people, an old man after a long life: and Jacob and Esau, his sons, put him in his last resting-place.
